p: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and
a: we will walk in his paths
s: : for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
d: he shall give us peace
we will keep his statutes
his truth shall be our guide

p: And one cried unto another, and said,
a: Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts
s: : the whole earth is full of his glory.
d: Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord
Righteous and true are thy holy ways
Praise and honor belong unto our God

p: And there shall come forth
a: a rod out of the stem of Jesse
s: , and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
d: a righteous branch from the throne of David
a holy prophet unto the house of Israel
a mighty savior out of the tribes of Judah

p: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
a: out of the wells of salvation
d: from the fountain of living waters
before the altar of his holy presence
by the river of his eternal mercies

a: O LORD, thou art my God
s: ; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
d: Great is the holy King
Thou art our strong refuge
Praise belongeth unto thee

p: And
a: the work of righteousness shall be peace
s: ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
d: the fear of the Lord is fountain of life
the path of the upright leadeth to glory
the fruit of wisdom is everlasting joy

p: For the LORD is our judge,
a: the LORD is our lawgiver
s: , the LORD is our king; he will save us.
d: the King of heaven is our shield
the Almighty is our strong tower
the Holy One is our Redeemer

p: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice,
a: and blossom as the rose
d: and bring forth pleasant fruits
with songs of joyful thanksgiving
in the beauty of the spring

a: A bruised reed shall he not break
s: , and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
d: The afflicted soul will he not despise
The humble heart shall find great mercy
The sheep of his flock shall not perish

p: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and
a: beside me there is no God
d: before my throne all shall bow
my glorious kingdom shall stand
my righteous word shall not fail

p: He is despised and rejected of men;
a: a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief
s: : and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
d: despised of all the rulers of the people
bearing our transgressions in his body
the righteous servant of the living God

a: Surely he hath borne our griefs
s: , and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
d: Truly he was wounded for our sins
He was delivered for our offenses
By his stripes we are all restored

a: Arise, shine; for thy light is come
s: , and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
d: Awake, O Zion, and put on thy strength
Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Jerusalem
Sing aloud, for the Lord hath redeemed thee

p: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD,
a: my soul shall be joyful in my God
s: ; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
d: my heart shall praise the holy King
my lips shall speak of all his truth
my tongue shall magnify his grace

p: Be not afraid of their faces:
a: for I am with thee to deliver thee
s: , saith the LORD.
d: my holy spirit shall guide thy ways
the words of my mouth shall not fail
my righteous hand will defend thy soul

p: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man
a: glory in his wisdom
s: , neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
d: trust in his riches
boast of his power
rejoice in his honor

p: But
a: the LORD is the true God
s: , he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
d: the Almighty is our King
the God of heaven reigneth
his holy name is exalted

a: He hath made the earth by his power
s: , he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
d: He ruleth the heavens in his majesty
He created all nations for his praise
He established the world in righteousness

p: For he shall be
a: as a tree planted by the waters
s: , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
d: like a green olive tree of God
as a cedar in the mount of Lebanon
as a fruitful branch in the garden

a: Am I a God at hand
s: , saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
d: Is not my word like fire
Can any hide in secret
Do not I fill heaven

p: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD.
a: Do not I fill heaven and earth?
s: saith the LORD.
d: Is not my word an enduring rock?
Doth not my power rule all nations?
Shall not my counsel stand forever?

p: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me,
a: and I will hearken unto you
d: and heal all your backslidings
and forgive your transgression
and restore peace unto Israel

p: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me
a: with all your heart
d: in faith and truth
with joyful songs
in holy reverence

p: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh:
a: is there any thing too hard for me?
d: can any man resist my holy decree?
is not the whole earth in my hand?
shall not my counsel surely stand?

a: The LORD is my portion
s: , saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
d: God is my salvation
He is my strong rock
My soul hath chosen him

p: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion
a: according to the multitude of his mercies
d: unto all them that call upon his name
in the day when he visiteth his people
before the face of all the congregation

a: For he doth not afflict willingly
s: nor grieve the children of men.
d: The Lord will not cast off for ever
His anger endureth but for a moment
He delighteth not in the death of any

a: Let us search and try our ways
s: , and turn again to the LORD.
d: Let us offer sacrifices of peace
Turn ye unto the God of Jacob
Bow down before his holy altar

p: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned;
a: renew our days as of old
d: forgive the sins of our fathers
restore the peace of Jerusalem
remember thy holy covenant

p: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of
a: the likeness of the glory of the LORD
s: . And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
d: the presence of the angel of his covenant
the majesty of his heavenly sanctuary
the throne of his righteousness on high

p: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right,
a: he shall surely live, he shall not die
d: the Lord will blot out all his sins
his soul shall dwell in quiet peace
he shall inherit the holy mountain

p: Have I any pleasure at all
a: that the wicked should die?
s: saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
d: that my people should perish?
in the destruction of men?
in the sorrow of the earth?

p: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I,
a: will both search my sheep
s: , and seek them out.
d: will heal the broken heart
will gather the outcasts
will restore my heritage

p: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered;
a: so will I seek out my sheep
s: , and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
d: so shall my hand guide them
thus will I restore Israel
so shall my peace be given

p: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season;
a: there shall be showers of blessing
d: the land shall yield her increase
peace shall abound in their tents
my holy presence shall dwell there

p: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered,
a: O Lord GOD, thou knowest
d: Thy holy arm can save them
Thou hast power over death
Thy word can give them life

p: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be,
a: The LORD is there
s: . …: Heb. Jehovah-shammah
d: God is our king
Peace unto Zion
Holy is our Lord

p: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven
a: set up a kingdom
s: , which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
d: establish his throne
reveal his power
judge all nations

p: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride
a: he is able to abase
d: he will bring down low
his wrath shall scatter
no king can withstand

p: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh
a: signs and wonders in heaven
s: and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
d: glory and honor on earth
righteousness before all
salvation unto his own

p: I saw in the night visions, and, behold,
a: one like the Son of man
s: came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
d: the prince of the angels
the holy king of heaven
the messenger of peace

p: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is
a: an everlasting dominion
s: , which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
d: a holy habitation
a glorious kingdom
a righteous sceptre

p: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord,
a: the great and dreadful God
s: , keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
d: the everlasting holy King
the righteous judge of men
the maker of all heavens

p: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses,
a: but for thy great mercies
d: and for thy covenant's sake
in faith of thy promise
through thy tender love

p: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are
a: called by thy name
d: cleansed by thy blood
kept by thy power
guided by thy hand
